name: test-lab
description: Write, run, and debug browser QA tests on test-lab.ai. Bundles the test-lab MCP connector plus skills for authoring plain-English test plans and hand-written Playwright scripts.

api_key.title: test-lab.ai API key
api_key.description: Optional. Create one at https://test-lab.ai/admin/settings/api-keys. Leave BLANK if you use `testlab login` or per-folder .test-lab.json bindings: a key set here overrides those everywhere, pinning every project to this one account. Blank is the right choice for multi-account setups.

profile.title: Account profile (optional)
profile.description: Optional. Name of a stored profile in ~/.test-lab/config.json. Leave BLANK to let each folder's .test-lab.json choose its own account; setting it here pins every folder to this profile.
